note: The script asks for 15 graphics and the end card; the library makes the first 10 in timeline order. Make the other five on the AIJ package plates, word for word: row 02:59-03:09 lower right small text aijustice.org/newsletter; rows 03:09-03:21, 03:30-03:42 and 03:50-03:58 Voice of "A.D." right above the subtitles; row 03:58-04:28 the survivor line Domestic Abuse Survivor represented by Americans for Immigrant Justice; rows 04:28-04:41, 04:41-04:49 and 04:49-04:58 the small credit The New York Times upper right; row 05:04-05:10 the super aijustice.org with no period. The newsletter headline, the A.D. illustration, the Krome photo and the client depiction are pictures, not library graphics. The end card in the repo is AIJ's vertical animated logo; this film is 16:9, so cut in AIJ's Horizontal Animated logo.
